premises.text: Cost is a determining factor in almost any transaction.
premises.evidence_span: Cost is a, if not the determining factor in almost any transaction.

premises.text: The cost of packing and shipping is a significant problem for retailers.
premises.evidence_span: this problem is the cost of packing and shipping.

premises.text: Determining the cost to pack and ship items is difficult.
premises.evidence_span: it's so hard to determine what it costs to pack and ship something.

premises.text: Retail shippers need to know shipping costs for diverse goods.
premises.evidence_span: Our customers are retail shippers. Our customers are small and medium-sized businesses that ship a diverse group of goods.

premises.text: The shipping market is fragmented, requiring different carriers for different items.
premises.evidence_span: The market itself is incredibly fragmented. Every different type of item requires a different type of carrier.

premises.text: Current shipping options are limited and often require extensive time to obtain quotes.
premises.evidence_span: it's going to take you hours or days to get quotes back from the few people that can give them to you.

premises.text: Shipping today lacks a centralized solution similar to travel agents.
premises.evidence_span: shipping today is just like travel was back then, only there's no agent.

premises.text: ShipHawk aggregates various shipping options into one platform.
premises.evidence_span: we have aggregated all of these different markets into one website.

premises.text: ShipHawk provides instant packing and shipping quotes.
premises.evidence_span: This allows us to provide customers with instant data, instant packing quotes, instant shipping quotes.

premises.text: ShipHawk makes money by collecting commissions from service providers.
premises.evidence_span: ShipHawk makes money by collecting a commission from all the service providers that we send business to.

value.text: Shipping becomes easier and more efficient for retailers.
value.evidence_span: help us make shipping easy for everyone.
